svg.title: Reliva single-host deployment on AWS
svg.desc: Users reach one EC2 instance through a Cloudflare Tunnel on the team's own domain; nginx fronts the web and three APIs backed by PostgreSQL, with S3 as the primary file store, scheduled backups to a locked S3 bucket, and an on-host observability stack.
svg.text: One EC2 instance, your Cloudflare domain in front, S3 as the file store, and verified backups.
AWS EC2 T3.MEDIUM · AP-SOUTHEAST-1 · DOCKER COMPOSE

g.text: Monitoring on the same host cannot report that the host itself died.
The uptime check and the Cloudflare Tunnel health alert are independent,
free, and detect an outage in roughly 3–5 minutes.
Tunnel alert is included on all Zero Trust plans (docs)
• No inbound ports; admin through SSM
• Upload: image ≤ 10 MiB, downscaled before S3
• S3 on AWS, MinIO only locally
• Scale up first; k3s multi-node later
